role_and_message.evidence: The framework retains continual detection with aggregate/task LoRA adapters, query-norm objectness and entropy-aware unknown mixing.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Frozen backbone/encoder/decoder, both LoRA adapter roles, incremental-update inset, query norm branches and localization/detection output remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: All source LoRA formulas, singular-value approximation, repeated T5 tick labels, alpha-mix weights, H/Hnorm/Hcls, Zcls/Zobj and final-score symbols are retained.

connections_and_direction.evidence: Image→backbone→encoder→memory→decoder→query features remains. H branches to normalization, feature norm/objectness, weighted class mix and localization; class/objectness scores enter entropy-aware mixing, while boxes and final scores converge at detections.

visual_encodings.evidence: Source frozen snowflakes and trainable flames remain. Aggregate and task adapters remain distinct and source photo detection-box colours are preserved.

examples_and_data.evidence: Five protected regions independently preserve both street photos/boxes, the full LoRA chart and formulas, feature map and encoder memory by integer nearest-neighbour enlargement.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The additional Sec.3.3 footer explicitly distinguishes trainable task adapters/detection heads/open-world parameters from frozen base/aggregate weights, directly supported by the source training description.

complete_visible_content.evidence: All original scientific labels and update equations remain visible. Repeated source task tick labels are preserved rather than editorially repaired.

remaining_limitations: Original scientific scope and source resolution retained. Repeated reference labels, colour choices and layout imperfections remain for independent quality scoring; no score-informed revision.
caption:
Figure 3. EW-DETR framework for Evolving-World Object Detection. An input image is processed by a frozen backbone and
transformer encoder–decoder equipped with aggregate (cid:0) ∆Wt−1 (cid:1) and task-specific (cid:0) ∆Wt (cid:1) LoRA adapters, yielding class-agnostic
agg task
query features. These queries are reparameterised by the Query-Norm Objectness Adapter and passed through a classification head and
an objectness head, whose outputs are combined by Entropy-aware Unknown Mixing module to produce calibrated class scores, while a
localisation head predicts bounding boxes to form final detections across tasks1 .
